span.p:
verified witness S
sum already equals T

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
is there a rival
in a wider pool?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
pool widened one
constraint at a time

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
S' = (S \ A) ∪ B
hits T exactly when Σ B = Σ A
so the whole search is a join

div.style: color: rgb(22, 24, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
would a collision
here be surprising?
